Hybrid OR / Angio Technologist / Interventional Radiology / Interventional Cardiology – Required Experience & Skills:
• Hybrid Operating Room Experience:
Significant experience working in a hybrid surgical suite that integrates a traditional operating room with advanced imaging technology, enabling surgeons to perform both open surgical and minimally invasive and complex endovascular procedures in the same setting.

Knowledge and experience with ordering, handling, and preparing specialized vascular supplies such as guidewires, grafts, catheters, stents, and other endovascular devices necessary to support complex vascular procedures.
• Sterile Technique & Surgical Environment:
